annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/546 of 12 March 2026 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 as regards harmonised standards for packaging machines, rough-terrain trucks, food processing machinery, cranes, cableway installations, agricultural and forestry machinery, lifts, rescue tools, hand-held tools, equipment in railway applications, aircraft ground support equipment, earth-moving machinery and refuse collection vehicles and correcting that Decision
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/546 of 12 March 2026 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 as regards harmonised standards for machinery (packaging machines, rough-terrain trucks, cranes, lifts, earth-moving machinery, refuse collection vehicles, etc.)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (L series)
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision updating the list of harmonised standards giving presumption of conformity with the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC. It adds new and revised EN standards for cranes, trucks, lifts and other machinery, defers withdrawal of old ones, restricts EN 474-1 and EN 1501-5, and corrects a restriction wording.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds references of new/revised EN harmonised standards to Annex I of Decision 2023/1586 under Directive 2006/42/EC.
Withdraws superseded standards such as EN 81-43:2009 and EN 1459-1:2017, with deferred effect from 20 January 2027.
EN 1501-5:2021 for refuse collection vehicle lifting devices maintained only with a restriction: no presumption of conformity for EHSR 1.1.7, 1.2.1, 1.5.11.
EN 474-1:2022 for earth-moving machinery maintained with a restriction on load test values.
Corrects 'tall trees' to 'tall branches' in row 622a restriction, applying from 13 January 2026.
